description: Erection of a rear roof dormer extension with juliet balcony and a second storey roof extension to the two storey rear outrigger, with the addition of three front roof lights, one rear roof light and one replacement first floor rear window.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A100-EX (Rev 01); A101 (Rev 01); A201 (Rev 01); A101-EX (Rev 01); A102 (Rev 01); A103 (Rev 01); 103-EX (Rev 01); A200 (Rev 01; A200-EX (Rev 01); A201 (Rev 01); A201-EX (Rev 01); A300 (Rev 01); A300-EX (Rev 01)  Received:  26 January 2022;  Unreferenced Block Plan; Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  08 December 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear roof dormer extension and second floor rear extension to the two storey rear outrigger hereby approved.
